body: Cannot confirm (previous message was an error on my part, set up the wrong script), please upload an MRP to make this easier to test and fix, this could be due to configuration error

Update on this issue. This morning, when creating the same simple project that I had recreated 4 times yesterday in 4.4.beta1, it now works. The only thing that has changed, is that I had a number of OS updates last night - I wonder if that had something to do with it. I run OS updates every time they are available, so my system wasn't out of date yesterday. I'm attaching the MRP as requested, as well as the OS update log on what exactly was updated on my system last night. I'm hoping this might provide some insight as to what may have been happening. Since it is now working, I will be happy to close this issue out, unless there was any other information that you would like.
Thanks so much for your help!
